source.note: Sanitized inventory. No hostname, credential, or internal topology is included.

coverage.reason: Confirmed authoritative history and complete proven holder snapshots are indexed, but the shipped adapter has no exhaustive mempool feed with stable pending lifecycle and disappearance handling.

routes.summary: Immutable feed page with a signed cursor

guarantees: Every ticker candidate is discovered without an upstream verified-only filter, then resolved to its verified winning Atomical ID.
Only the verified winning Atomical ID is published. The reference is the lower-case ticker and the winning compact Atomical ID is retained in protocol details.
Holder rows are aggregated by address and must sum exactly to circulating supply.
A mismatch, a null address, a truncated page sequence, a changing declared total, or a changing chain tip aborts the entire poll. No partial authoritative snapshot is committed.
Activity contains authoritative deployment, direct and decentralised mint, transfer, burn, and protocol-operation records.
Supply and holder snapshots are the authoritative state, so activity events publish empty wallet and supply deltas to prevent downstream double application.
Cursor signatures use a secret separate from the feed bearer token.
A cursor-free request copies a bounded number of rows per request and returns a retryable unavailable response until the generation is ready.
At most 64 unexpired generations are retained.
